summary.en: Mai Takigawa accidentally kills her boyfriend Yusuke Tsuda in self-defense after misunderstanding him as a burglar, but in reality, he along with Mai's best friend Riko Totsuka planned a surprise party for her birthday. Location: Mai Takigawa's apartment Victim: Yusuke Tsuda Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Culprit: Mai Takigawa Takagi and Sato arrive at the scene to investigate, and also does Conan, who was at the apartment complex at the time and heard the scream along with Agasa and the Detective Boys. Conan and the police discover clues that make them think that there's more behind this case.
